name: TINY-16
description: The machine to start with: one register, A, and seven instructions, LOAD, ADD, SUB, OUT, JUMP, JZ and HALT. Small enough to follow every tick, and enough to print, add and loop.

programs.name: Say Hi
programs.description: LOAD a character into A, OUT prints it
ADD works on character codes too: '2' + 3 is '5'

programs.name: Count down from 9 to 0
programs.description: A loop with a label, JUMP back and JZ out
